 Sydney Thunder name unchanged squad for WBBL clash with Perth Scorchers
 Sydney Thunder name unchanged squad for WBBL clash with Perth Scorchers ©WBBL/CW 
 By Cricket World & Cricket NSW 
 Wednesday 4 November 2026 
 Women's Big Bash League 
 Women T20 series Schedule 11th Match, Sydney Live Sydney Thunder Women Perth Scorchers Women 147/1 18 ov ST-W elected to bowl
 Sydney Thunder Women elected to bowl
 Live scores and commentary 
 Sydney Thunder will retain their winning squad for their top-of-the-table WBBL|12 clash with Perth Scorchers at Drummoyne Oval. Both teams have opened the season with consecutive victories.
 Thunder currently sit level at the top of the Women’s Big Bash League 2026 standings with Sydney Sixers and Perth Scorchers after beginning their campaign with back-to-back wins.
 Head Coach Lisa Keightley praised the collective nature of Thunder’s performances but stressed that the players must deliver another strong display on home turf.
 Sydney Thunder Head Coach Lisa Keightley said: 
 “It’s really nice to see the team put on two strong performances. I’m pleased that we haven’t relied on any one player. It’s been a real team effort. If we can continue to play this way it will really set us up to put pressure on teams and give us an opportunity to win matches. 
 “The Scorchers have also started the competition well so it’s going to be a very competitive match. They have some key players that we will need to keep quiet but if we can continue to improve as a group I feel like we can put them under pressure and give us the best opportunity to win the match.”
